global_invariants: Objective truth, GM solution or conclusion, clue, observation, claim, evidence, hypothesis and Player knowledge remain separately typed.
Visibility, confidence, relevance, authenticity and source reliability never become objective truth probability by implication.
Contradiction records identify incompatible material for review and never automatically adjudicate which side is true.
False leads, lies, corrupted evidence and unreliable testimony remain attributable authored content and cannot silently rewrite objective truth.
Evidence references owning-domain objects and PPIA-09 stores Investigation-local state without copying Item, Creature or NPC, Vehicle, Setting, Location or Event ownership.
World and Setting chronology remains PPIA-12-owned; case timelines may reference it only through permission-safe knowledge projections.
Important-information redundancy is reviewable from source guidance without imposing a universal clue count on every mystery.
Dynamic or extra clue delivery retains author, trigger or delivery reason, source, audience and durable Event provenance.
Authorization filtering occurs before protected truth, clues, links, sources, counts, search, export, realtime, diagnostics, notifications or AI context are resolved or aggregated.
Spatial clue-board layout is presentation state; semantic typed-edge and ordered nonvisual forms remain authoritative.
Every authoritative mutation requires expected_version plus operation_id and ambiguous outcomes require operation-status and current-version lookup before retry.
AI-generated organization, theory, connection, clue or mystery material remains proposal-only until explicitly accepted by authorized action.
No contract activates application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, testers, paid services or production credentials.

rules: Annotations are attributable assessments, not objective truth probabilities.
No universal numeric scale is required; a Campaign or rules profile may supply a vocabulary when explicitly adopted.
Unknown or unset remains valid and must not be silently defaulted.
Witness belief, statement truth, source reliability and evidence authenticity remain independently authorable.
Timeline entries reference owning Events, Setting chronology or attributable claims instead of copying authority.
Temporal ordering may expose contradictions but never adjudicates objective truth automatically.
Player-visible case chronology is permission-filtered separately from hidden Setting or GM chronology.
A contradiction record references the material in tension and its authored rationale.
Resolved review state records an authorized explanation or conclusion reference; it does not erase either historical input.
Contradiction detection and review never decide which source is true without explicit authorized conclusion evidence.

global_mutation_protocol: authorize current subject, role, Campaign membership and delegation before protected reference resolution
filter protected truth, clue, source and audience fields before derived projection or diagnostic input
revalidate Investigation and referenced object versions
on ambiguous response query operation status and current version before retry
compatible duplicate returns prior result or status while conflicting operation-ID reuse fails safely
emit attributable durable Event or receipt only after accepted atomic mutation
